description:
[read-only] The brand's published posts ranked for a boost (reach, engagement rate, link clicks, recency and timeliness), with window/windowLabel (Boost now or Upcoming), separate missedWindows for expired posts that cannot be boosted, upcomingDates from the shared season config, score parts, the call-to-action link found, and whether an ad account is connected for the network. Removed posts, posts with no call to action and networks a boost can't run on are left out. Read-only: nothing is boosted or charged.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/boost-candidates.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Omitted: the key's brand (a brand-bound key) or the owner's active brand.

days.description: How many days back to read (clamped).

include.description: Also list posts on networks a boost can't run on.

name: ads_boost_candidates
title: Posts worth boosting
